name: Concert on the Terrace: El Sonidero Insurgente
description: Kick off the weekend early with a free outdoor concert featuring the Argentine band's lively fusion of Latin American tradition and modern urban sounds.
longDescription:
On July 2, 2026, Casa da Música hosts a free outdoor concert on its terrace, presenting El Sonidero Insurgente. This Argentine band is known for its musical approach that blends traditional Latin American rhythms with contemporary urban influences. Their sound incorporates elements from cumbia, salsa, and other regional genres, interpreted through a modern lens.

Attendees can expect an evening concert in an open-air setting, offering a relaxed atmosphere. The event is designed to provide an early start to the weekend, suitable for a general audience interested in world music. The terrace of Casa da Música provides a distinct backdrop for the performance.

This is a free event, with no tickets required for entry. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station, a short walk from the venue. The event is open to all ages.
